ITEM 1 | Cluster of about 60 smooth, tan-to-brown oval pieces with dry, matte skins and slightly ridged shapes, piled loosely about 1 cm high on the left side of the plate | 35 g
ITEM 2 | Mound of white, fluffy, separate short grains with a dull, moist-looking surface, loosely piled about 2 cm high in the lower center of the plate | 90 g
ITEM 3 | About 18 dark red-to-purple round pieces, about 1.5 to 2 cm across, with glossy, smooth skins, clustered in the upper center of the plate | 100 g
ITEM 4 | One pale green-yellow round piece, about 1.5 cm across, with a smooth, slightly glossy skin, sitting among the dark red pieces at the top | 6 g
ITEM 5 | Six small bright red, glossy, round pieces, about 2.5 to 3 cm across, smooth and taut-skinned, scattered on the right side of the plate near the greens | 90 g
ITEM 6 | Cluster of flat, broad, dark green leaves with crinkled edges and a matte, slightly moist surface, covering about one-eighth of the plate on the upper right | 25 g
